items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: we were just playing with two or three intervals... David starts with a color

ctx.x: Okay so if there’s nine or ten how do you get started so that this one is different than the last one? Does someone suggest something at least? Tempo, a feeling?

Yes. That’s usually how it starts, that somebody starts with an idea, the drums start with a rhythm or David starts with a color and then for instance on one piece we were just playing with two or three intervals and that is what happened. Or in another piece we focused more on the rhythmic motif. Or on one other piece maybe we stayed largely in © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

one tonal center but everything else shifts, the time, and the rhythms you know. So there seems to be like one thing that we agree on and then the rest is pretty open. So it’s not like okay playing anything, whatever anybody wants at any time.
